entities.title: zazz-sdk
entities.summary: The zazz-sdk crate, library name zazz: the SDK zazz scripts are written and tested with, and the protocol code zazzled and zazz-worker share with them.
entities.purpose: Holds the one copy of the script-side API (handlers, the call context, JSON, errors, HTTP), the launcher protocol both sides speak and the zazz::test harness, so a script, its tests, zazzled and zazz-worker agree by construction. Contains the crate manifest (Cargo.toml, a member of the macos/rust workspace) and the source in src/.
boundaries: No dependencies, only std: zazzled compiles the source files itself with rustc for each script build (Cargo.toml comment; macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz/sdk.rs).
A library only: nothing is installed or released from this folder.
Building, sandboxing and calling scripts belong to zazzled and zazz-worker; the .zazz file and zazz.json belong to zazz-format (macos/rust/zazz-format).

relationships.description: The archive format the scripts built with this SDK are shipped in.
